chapters.content:
PART 1 — ANALOGY KA BASIC CONCEPT
Sabse pehle ek line yaad rakho:
Analogy = Do cheezon ke beech jo relationship hai, wahi relationship doosri do cheezon ke beech find karna.
Iska common format:
A : B :: C : ?
Isko padhte hain:
A is related to B in the same way C is related to ?
Example 1
Dog : Puppy :: Cat : ?
Socho:
Dog ka baby → Puppy
Toh Cat ka baby → Kitten
Answer = Kitten
Yahan relationship hai:
Animal → Baby
________________________________________
Example 2
Hand : Finger :: Foot : ?
Hand mein kya hota hai?
→ Finger
Foot mein kya hota hai?
→ Toe
Answer = Toe
Relationship:
Whole → Part
________________________________________
Example 3
Bird : Fly :: Fish : ?
Bird ka characteristic/action?
→ Fly
Fish ka characteristic/action?
→ Swim
Relationship:
Animal → Action
________________________________________
🔑 Sabse important point
Analogy mein answer ko directly guess nahi karna hai.
Pehle:
Step 1
A aur B ka exact relationship identify karo.
Step 2
Usi relationship ko C par apply karo.
Step 3
Answer nikalo.
Example:
Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
Pehle:
Doctor → Hospital
Relationship:
Person → Workplace
Ab:
Teacher → ?
School
✅ Answer = School
________________________________________
Analogy mein relationships ke bahut saare types hote hain
Abhi sirf inko identify karna seekho:
1. Person → Workplace
Doctor : Hospital
Teacher : School
2. Animal → Baby
Dog : Puppy
Cat : Kitten
3. Whole → Part
Body : Hand
Hand : Finger
4. Object → Function
Pen : Write
Knife : Cut
5. Person → Tool
Carpenter : Hammer
Farmer : Plough
6. Place → Thing found there
Library : Books
Museum : Artifacts
7. Cause → Effect
Fire : Smoke
Rain : Flood
8. Synonym
Big : Large
Small : Little
9. Antonym
Hot : Cold
Day : Night
10. Young → Adult
Calf : Cow
Foal : Horse
CET ke liye in relationships ko identify karna bahut important hai.
________________________________________
🧠 Ek golden trick
Question dekho:
A : B :: C : ?
Apne mind mein ye sentence banao:
"A ka B se kya relation hai?"
Phir:
"C ka same relation kis se hai?"
Bas.
📝 Ab Part 1 ki mini practice

PART 1 — LEVEL 2: Relationship Identification
Analogy mein sabse badi mistake hoti hai:
A aur B ke beech koi bhi relation dekhkar answer laga dena.
Humein exact relation pakadna hai.
Example:
Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
Pen ka kaam → Write
Knife ka kaam → Cut
✅ Answer = Cut
Yahan relation hai:
Object → Function
________________________________________
🔹 Type 1: Object → Function
Question	Relation	Answer
Pen : Write	Object → Function	Write
Knife : Cut	Object → Function	Cut
Camera : Photograph	Object → Function	Photograph
Thermometer : Temperature	Object → Function	Measure temperature
पहचानने की trick:
Khud se pucho:
"Pehli cheez ka kaam kya hai?"
________________________________________
🔹 Type 2: Person → Workplace
Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
Doctor kaha kaam karta hai?
→ Hospital
Teacher kaha kaam karta hai?
→ School
✅ School
Examples:
•	Judge : Court 
•	Farmer : Farm 
•	Pilot : Airport 
•	Chef : Kitchen 
Trick:
"Ye person normally kaha kaam karta hai?"
________________________________________
🔹 Type 3: Whole → Part
Hand : Finger :: Foot : ?
Hand ka ek part → Finger
Foot ka ek part → Toe
✅ Toe
Examples:
•	Car : Wheel 
•	Tree : Branch 
•	House : Room 
•	Book : Page 
Trick:
"B pehli cheez ka ek hissa hai?"
________________________________________
🔹 Type 4: Animal → Young One
Dog : Puppy :: Cat : ?
Dog ka young one → Puppy
Cat ka young one → Kitten
✅ Kitten
Examples:
•	Cow : Calf 
•	Horse : Foal 
•	Lion : Cub 
•	Goat : Kid 
________________________________________
🔹 Type 5: Animal → Sound
Dog : Bark :: Cat : ?
Dog ki sound → Bark
Cat ki sound → Meow
✅ Meow
Examples:
•	Lion : Roar 
•	Snake : Hiss 
•	Horse : Neigh 
•	Cow : Moo 
________________________________________
🔹 Type 6: Synonym
Big : Large :: Small : ?
Big = Large
Small = Little
✅ Little
Yahan dono words ka same/similar meaning hai.
Examples:
•	Happy : Glad 
•	Fast : Quick 
•	Begin : Start 
•	Smart : Intelligent 
________________________________________
🔹 Type 7: Antonym
Hot : Cold :: Day : ?
Hot ↔ Cold
Day ↔ Night
✅ Night
Examples:
•	Up : Down 
•	Rich : Poor 
•	Black : White 
•	Old : Young 
________________________________________
🔥 सबसे जरूरी बात
Exam mein kabhi-kabhi ek pair ke beech multiple relations possible hote hain.
Example:
Bird : Nest
Bird nest mein rehta hai.
To relationship:
Animal → Home
Ab:
Lion : ?
→ Den
Isliye answer Tiger nahi hoga, kyunki humein same relationship chahiye.
________________________________________
🧠 5-Second Method
Har analogy mein ye 3 steps follow karo:
Step 1
A → B ko dekho
Step 2
Pucho:
"A ka B se exact relation kya hai?"
Step 3
Same relation:
C → ?
________________________________________
Example
Book : Page :: Tree : ?
Book ka part → Page
Tree ka part → Branch
✅ Branch
________________________________________
🎯 Ab tumhara next test

🧠 PART 2A — Word Analogy: Relationship ko पकड़ना
Basic format:
A : B :: C : ?
Humein A → B ka relationship identify karke wahi C → ? par lagana hai.
________________________________________
1️⃣ Profession → Place
Example:
Teacher : School :: Doctor : ?
Teacher ka workplace = School
Doctor ka workplace = Hospital
✅ Answer: Hospital
Aur examples:
•	Lawyer → Court 
•	Farmer → Farm 
•	Chef → Kitchen 
•	Pilot → Airport 
•	Soldier → Army 
⚠️ Dhyan do: kabhi-kabhi profession aur workplace confusing ho sakte hain.
Teacher : School
Yahan relationship person → workplace hai, na ki person → profession.
________________________________________
2️⃣ Profession → Tool
Ye bahut important pattern hai.
Carpenter : Saw :: Barber : ?
Carpenter ka tool = Saw
Barber ka tool = Scissors
✅ Answer: Scissors
Examples:
•	Doctor → Stethoscope 
•	Farmer → Plough 
•	Tailor → Needle 
•	Painter → Brush 
•	Writer → Pen 
Trick:
Pucho:
"Ye person apna kaam karne ke liye kya use karta hai?"
________________________________________
3️⃣ Object → Function
Pen : Writing :: Knife : ?
Pen ka function = Writing
Knife ka function = Cutting
Examples:
•	Camera → Photography 
•	Refrigerator → Cooling 
•	Clock → Time 
•	Thermometer → Temperature 
•	Keyboard → Typing 
Trick:
"Is object ka main purpose kya hai?"
________________________________________
4️⃣ Material → Product
Ye bhi frequently useful pattern hai.
Gold : Jewellery :: Wood : ?
Gold se jewellery banti hai.
Wood se kya banta hai?
→ Furniture
✅ Answer: Furniture
Examples:
•	Leather → Shoes 
•	Cotton → Cloth 
•	Wheat → Flour 
•	Milk → Butter 
•	Clay → Pot 
Trick:
"Pehli cheez se doosri cheez banti hai?"
________________________________________
5️⃣ Animal → Home
Lion : Den :: Bird : ?
Lion ka home = Den
Bird ka home = Nest
Examples:
•	Dog → Kennel 
•	Horse → Stable 
•	Cow → Shed 
•	Rabbit → Burrow 
•	Bee → Hive 
________________________________________
6️⃣ Cause → Effect
Fire : Smoke :: Rain : ?
Fire se kya hota hai?
→ Smoke
Rain ka possible effect?
→ Flood
Relationship:
Cause → Effect
⚠️ Yahan exact relationship dekhna important hai.
________________________________________
7️⃣ Object → Material
Chair : Wood :: Ring : ?
Chair kis material se commonly bani hoti hai?
→ Wood
Ring?
→ Gold
Examples:
•	Shirt → Cotton 
•	Bottle → Glass 
•	Table → Wood 
•	Coin → Metal 
________________________________________
🔥 Ab ek important CET technique
Kabhi question mein options mein related words ke multiple answers honge.
Example:
Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
Options:
A. Book
B. School
C. Student
D. Pen
Teacher ka Book se bhi relation hai, Student se bhi relation hai.
Lekin Doctor → Hospital ka exact relation hai:
Profession → Workplace
Isliye:
Teacher → School
✅ B
याद रखो:
सबसे common relation नहीं, बल्कि सबसे EXACT relation चुनना है।
________________________________________
📝 PART 2A Practice
Abhi difficult questions nahi. Pehle relationship identification strong karte hain.

Answers 1–10 bhejo. Iske baad main tumhe Word Analogy ke thode tricky questions dunga, jahan 2 options related honge aur tumhe exact relationship pakadna padega.
❌ Q5 ko microscopic way mein samjho
Fire : Smoke :: Rain : ?
Fire → Smoke
Yahan relationship hai:
Cause → Effect
•	Fire = cause 
•	Smoke = effect 
Ab Rain ka effect kya ho sakta hai?
Rain → Flood
इसलिए answer = C. Flood
Tumne Water choose kiya.
Problem ye hai ki:
Rain → Water bhi related hai, lekin ye Cause → Effect wala relationship nahi hai.
Rain water se related hai, lekin question mein relationship effect ka tha.
🔑 Golden Rule
Analogy mein:
Sirf relation hona enough nahi hai; same TYPE ka relation hona chahiye.
________________________________________

PART 2C — Word Analogy के Major Patterns
इसमें हम लगभग 15–20 अलग-अलग relationships cover करेंगे, जैसे:
•	Worker → Tool 
•	Worker → Product 
•	Person → Place 
•	Animal → Home 
•	Animal → Sound 
•	Material → Product 
•	Cause → Effect 
•	Object → Function 
•	Part → Whole 
•	Creator → Creation 
•	Male → Female 
•	Young One → Adult 
•	Country → Capital 
•	Country → Currency 
•	Instrument → Measurement
🧠 PART 2C — Important Word Relationships
1. Male → Female
King : Queen :: Man : Woman
Relationship:
Male → Female
Examples:
•	Bull → Cow 
•	Horse → Mare 
•	Lion → Lioness 
•	Actor → Actress 
•	Uncle → Aunt 
⚠️ Dhyan: har word ka grammatical gender nahi, actual male-female pair dekho.
________________________________________
2. Young One → Adult
Calf : Cow :: Foal : Horse
Calf = young cow
Foal = young horse
Relationship:
Young → Adult
Examples:
•	Puppy → Dog 
•	Kitten → Cat 
•	Cub → Lion 
•	Chick → Hen/Bird 
________________________________________
3. Creator → Creation
Author : Book :: Painter : Painting
Author creates Book.
Painter creates Painting.
Relationship:
Creator → Creation
Examples:
•	Poet → Poem 
•	Composer → Music 
•	Sculptor → Sculpture 
•	Director → Film 
________________________________________
4. Country → Capital
India : New Delhi :: France : Paris
Relationship:
Country → Capital
Examples:
•	Japan → Tokyo 
•	Nepal → Kathmandu 
•	Bangladesh → Dhaka 
•	Australia → Canberra 
________________________________________
5. Country → Currency
India : Rupee :: Japan : Yen
Relationship:
Country → Currency
Examples:
•	USA → Dollar 
•	UK → Pound 
•	Bangladesh → Taka 
•	China → Yuan 
________________________________________
6. Instrument → Measurement
Thermometer : Temperature :: Barometer : Pressure
Thermometer measures temperature.
Barometer measures atmospheric pressure.
Relationship:
Instrument → What it measures
Examples:
•	Speedometer → Speed 
•	Ammeter → Current 
•	Voltmeter → Voltage 
•	Odometer → Distance 
________________________________________
7. Part → Whole
Abhi tak humne Whole → Part dekha tha.
Example:
Finger : Hand :: Wheel : Car
Finger is a part of Hand.
Wheel is a part of Car.
Relationship:
Part → Whole
⚠️ Direction important hai:
Hand : Finger = Whole → Part
Finger : Hand = Part → Whole
________________________________________
8. Object → Material
Table : Wood :: Shirt : Cotton
Table is made of wood.
Shirt is made of cotton.
Relationship:
Object → Material
________________________________________
9. Material → Product
Iska reverse:
Wood : Furniture :: Cotton : Cloth
Relationship:
Material → Product
याद रखो:
Wood → Furniture
Material → Product
लेकिन
Furniture → Wood
Object → Material
Direction बदल गई तो answer भी बदल सकता है.
________________________________________
10. Cause → Effect
Exercise : Fitness :: Study : Knowledge
Exercise leads to fitness.
Study leads to knowledge.
Relationship:
Cause → Effect
________________________________________
🔥 अब एक बहुत important concept: Direction
Analogy में relationship की direction बहुत important है.
Example:
Doctor : Hospital
Person → Workplace
लेकिन:
Hospital : Doctor
Place → Person
दोनों related हैं, लेकिन relationship अलग है.
इसी तरह:
Wood : Furniture
Material → Product
Furniture : Wood
Product → Material
🎯 CET Trick
हर question में arrow लगाओ:
A → B
फिर वही arrow:
C → ?
बस direction उलटी मत करना.
________________________________________

NUMBER ANALOGY

इसमें हम बिल्कुल zero से शुरू करेंगे:

1.   Number Analogy क्या है?
2. Addition/Subtraction pattern
3. Multiplication/Division pattern
4. Square/Cube based analogy
5. Difference pattern
6. Mixed operations
7. Two-step/three-step patterns
8. CET-level tricky questions
9. Final Number Analogy test

🔢 PART 3A — Number Analogy का Basic Concept

Number Analogy का सामान्य format:

A : B :: C : ?

लेकिन यहाँ words के बजाय numbers के बीच mathematical relationship ढूँढना होता है।

Example 1

5 : 10 :: 7 : ?

देखो:

5 → 10

यहाँ:

5 × 2 = 10

तो वही relation:

7 × 2 = 14

✅ Answer = 14

Example 2

8 : 12 :: 10 : ?

8 → 12

8 + 4 = 12

तो:

10 + 4 = 14

✅ Answer = 14

Example 3

20 : 15 :: 12 : ?

20 → 15

20 − 5 = 15

तो:

12 − 5 = 7

✅ Answer = 7

🧠 सबसे पहला Rule

Number Analogy में हमेशा पहले:

A → B

का mathematical relation निकालो।

फिर वही operation:

C → ?

पर लगाओ।

🔥 सबसे Common Operations

शुरुआत में आपको मुख्यतः ये operations check करने हैं:

3. Multiplication

6 : 30

6 × 5 = 30

4. Division

5. Square

5 : 25

5² = 25

6. Cube

3 : 27

3³ = 27

⚠️ लेकिन एक बहुत जरूरी बात

हर question में केवल + / − / × / ÷ देखकर answer मत निकालना।

Example:

5 : 25 :: 7 : ?

5 → 25

Possible:

5 × 5 = 25

लेकिन यह actually:

5² = 25

तो:

7² = 49

① + / −

② × / ÷

③ Square / Cube

🔢 PART 3D — Tricky Number Analogy

1. n² + Constant

Example:

5 : 28 :: 7 : ?

Pehle 5 → 28 dekho:

  • 5² = 25
  • 25 + 3 = 28

To rule hai:

n² + 3

Ab 7 par:

  • 7² = 49
  • 49 + 3 = 52

✅ Answer = 52

2. n² − Constant

Example:

6 : 32 :: 8 : ?

  • 6² = 36
  • 36 − 4 = 32

Rule = n² − 4

Ab:

  • 8² = 64
  • 64 − 4 = 60

✅ Answer = 60

3. n³ + Constant

Example:

4 : 68 :: 5 : ?

  • 4³ = 64
  • 64 + 4 = 68

Yahan rule actually n³ + n hai.

Ab 5:

  • 5³ = 125
  • 125 + 5 = 130

✅ Answer = 130

4. n × (n + 1)

Ye important pattern hai.

Example:

5 : 30 :: 7 : ?

5 × (5+1)

= 5 × 6
= 30

Ab 7:

7 × 8 = 56

✅ Answer = 56

Dhyan do:

n × (n+1) = n²+n

Isliye ye wahi pattern hai jo hum pehle kar chuke hain.

5. n × (n − 1)

Example:

6 : 30 :: 8 : ?

6 × (6−1)

= 6 × 5
= 30

Ab:

8 × 7 = 56

✅ Answer = 56

Ye mathematically:

n² − n

ke equal hai.

6. Mixed Pattern

Kabhi question mein pattern simple +/− nahi hota.

Example:

4 : 19 :: 6 : ?

Check:

4 × 4 = 16
16 + 3 = 19

Rule:

n² + 3

Ab:

6² + 3
= 36 + 3
= 39

n²

Step 8

ya
n³ ± n

Sabse important: pehla relation jo fit ho us par turant mat rukna. Dekho kya woh uniquely aur consistently fit hota hai.

Advanced analogy में हमेशा n², n³ ही नहीं होगा। कभी:

  • × और + साथ में
  • × और − साथ में
  • दो numbers का product
  • digits के साथ operation
  • difference/square का relation
  • अलग-अलग लेकिन consistent mathematical pattern

आ सकता है।

इसलिए हमारा तरीका होगा:

पहले simple pattern → फिर mixed pattern → फिर advanced pattern

🔹 Type 1: Multiplication + Addition

Example

7 : 17 :: 9 : ?

देखो:

7 × 2 = 14
14 + 3 = 17

Rule:

n × 2 + 3

अब 9:

9 × 2 = 18
18 + 3 = 21

✅ Answer = 21

🔹 Type 2: Multiplication − Addition

Example

8 × 3 = 24
24 − 3 = 21

Rule:

अब:

= 30 − 3
= 27

✅ Answer = 27

🔹 Type 3: Multiplication + Multiplication

Example

यानी:

अब:

✅ Answer = 72

यह pattern हमने पहले भी देखा है।

🔹 Type 4: Product of Consecutive Numbers

9 × 8 = 72

यानी:

अब:

🔹 Type 5: Difference Based

अब थोड़ा ध्यान देना।

Example

8 × 7 = 56

लेकिन इसे ऐसे भी देख सकते हैं:

8² − 8 = 64 − 8 = 56

इसलिए:

10² − 10
= 100 − 10
= 90

यहाँ हमें equivalent form पहचाननी है।

🔹 Type 6: Digit-Based Pattern

ये थोड़ा अलग है।

Example

24 : 8 :: 35 : ?

24 के digits:

2 × 4 = 8

अब:

3 × 5 = 15

✅ Answer = 15

यहाँ number को पूरा number मानकर calculation नहीं करनी; digits को अलग-अलग देखना है।

🔹 Type 7: Digit Addition

Example

36 : 9 :: 47 : ?

3 + 6 = 9

अब:

4 + 7 = 11

✅ Answer = 11

🔹 Type 8: Square of Digits / Digit Relationship

Example:

23 : 13 :: 14 : ?

2² + 3²
= 4 + 9
= 13

अब:

1² + 4²
= 1 + 16
= 17

✅ Answer = 17

🧠 Advanced Pattern पहचानने का Order

🧠 PART 3 — ALPHABET ANALOGY

Ye Rajasthan CET Reasoning ke liye important topic hai. Isko bhi microscopic way se, basic se exam level tak karenge.

Alphabet Analogy kitne parts mein?

Hum ise 7 parts mein karenge:

1.    Alphabet ki basic position/value ⭐

2.    Simple Alphabet Analogy

3.    Forward & Backward Position

4.    Letter Gap / Difference

5.    Mixed & Double-Letter Patterns

6.    CET-level tricky patterns

🔤 PART 4B — Simple Alphabet Analogy

1. Basic Rule

Word analogy की तरह यहाँ भी वही rule है:

पहले pair में जो relationship है, वही दूसरे pair में लगाना है।

Example:

A : D :: F : ?

A → D = +3

तो F → ?

F → G → H → I

✅ Answer = I

2. Forward Movement

जब दूसरा letter alphabet में आगे है, तो + relation होगा।

Example

C : G :: H : ?

C = 3
G = 7

Difference:

7 − 3 = 4

अब H:

H + 4 = L

✅ C : G :: H : L

Example

D : J :: M : ?

D = 4
J = 10

Difference = +6

M = 13

13 + 6 = 19 = S

✅ Answer = S

3. Backward Movement

दूसरा letter पहले से पीछे हो तो backward movement।

Example

J : F :: P : ?

J = 10
F = 6

Difference = −4

P = 16

16 − 4 = 12 = L

✅ Answer = L

4. Same Gap, Different Letters

यह CET में बहुत common है।

Example

B : F :: K : ?

B → F = +4

तो K → ?

K → L → M → N → O

✅ Answer = O

5. Letter Pair Analogy

अब एक से ज्यादा letters भी हो सकते हैं।

Example:

AB : CD :: EF : ?

देखो:

A → C = +2
B → D = +2

तो:

E → G
F → H

✅ Answer = GH

6. दोनों Letters पर Same Operation

Example:

BC : EF :: HI : ?

B → E = +3

⚠️ लेकिन याद रखो: ऐसी transformation तभी चुनो जब options और pair इसे clearly support करें।

9️⃣ Opposite/Reverse Position

Example:

E : V :: H : ?

E = 5

27 − 5 = 22 = V

H = 8

27 − 8 = 19 = S

✅ Answer = S

यह reverse alphabet है।

🔟 Mixed Pattern — Shift + Reverse

Example:

B : X :: D : ?

B का reverse = Y.

लेकिन Y से −1 = X.

तो rule:

Reverse + −1

D का reverse = W

W −1 = V

✅ Answer = V

इस type में पहले reverse निकालो, फिर extra shift apply करो।

1️⃣1️⃣ Pair Position Relationship

Example:

AB : 3 :: CD : ?

A + B:

1 + 2 = 3

C + D:

3 + 4 = 7

✅ Answer = 7

यहाँ output letter नहीं बल्कि number हो सकता है।

1️⃣2️⃣ Pair Multiplication

Example:

BC : 6 :: DE : ?

B = 2
C = 3

2 × 3 = 6

D = 4
E = 5

4 × 5 = 20

✅ Answer = 20

🧠 सबसे Important CET Strategy

अगर question है:

A : B :: C : ?

तो पहले पूछो:

A से B कैसे पहुँचे?

फिर exactly वही operation C पर लगाओ।

अगर:

AB : CD :: EF : ?

तो पूछो:

A→C और B→D में क्या relationship है?

और फिर वही:

E→? और F→?

🚨 Common Traps

Trap 1 — केवल visually देखना

C → G

बस चार letters आगे मत गिनो; position से verify करो:

7 − 3 = 4.

Trap 2 — Reverse को backward समझना

A → Z

यह normal −1 नहीं है।

यह reverse/opposite alphabet है।

Trap 3 — Z के बाद रुक जाना

अगर:

Y + 3

तो:

Y → Z → A → B

Answer = B

Trap 4 — Pair का order भूल जाना

AB → BA

यह सिर्फ letters का reversal है।

📚 PART 4F — Notes में यह Master Table रखो

PART 4A — CODING–DECODING BASICS 🔐

1. Coding-Decoding क्या है?

मान लो:

CAT → DBU

यहाँ हर letter को +1 किया गया है:

  • C → D
  • A → B
  • T → U

इसलिए अगर पूछा जाए:

DOG → ?

तो:

  • D → E
  • O → P
  • G → H

Answer = EPH

यही Coding-Decoding का basic concept है।

2. सबसे जरूरी चीज — Alphabet Position

Coding-Decoding में Alphabet की position बहुत काम आती है।

Letter

Golden Rule:

A = 1 से Z = 26

3. Type 1 — Forward Coding (+)

इसमें हर letter को आगे shift किया जाता है।

Example:

CAT → DBU

C + 1 = D
A + 1 = B
T + 1 = U

इसलिए:

DOG → EPH

D + 1 = E
O + 1 = P
G + 1 = H

+2 Example

CAT → ECV

C → E = +2
A → C = +2
T → V = +2

तो:

DOG → FQI

D → F
O → Q
G → I

4. Type 2 — Backward Coding (−)

इसमें letters को पीछे shift किया जाता है।

Example:

DOG → CNF

D − 1 = C
O − 1 = N
G − 1 = F

इसलिए:

CAT → BZS

C → B
A → Z
T → S

⚠️ Important

अगर A से पीछे जाना है:

A − 1 = Z

यहाँ circular alphabet इस्तेमाल होता है।

5. Type 3 — Reverse Alphabet Coding

इसमें alphabet को उल्टा कर दिया जाता है।

Normal:

A B C D E F G ... Z

Reverse:

Z Y X W V U T ... A

इसलिए:

6. Reverse Alphabet का Formula

अगर letter की position n है:

Reverse Position = 27 − n

Example:

C

C = 3

27 − 3 = 24

24 = X

इसलिए:

C → X

H

H = 8

27 − 8 = 19

19 = S

इसलिए:

H → S

7. Type 4 — Different Shift Coding

हर letter पर अलग-अलग shift हो सकता है।

Example:

ABC → BDF

देखिए:

A → B = +1
B → D = +2
C → F = +3

Rule:

+1, +2, +3

अब:

DEF → ?

D +1 = E
E +2 = G
F +3 = I

Answer:

EGI

⚠️ CET Trick

अगर simple +1 या −1 काम नहीं कर रहा है तो देखें:

+1, +2, +3...

या

−1, −2, −3...

8. Type 5 — Alternate Coding

इसमें alternate letters पर अलग-अलग operation होता है।

Example:

ABC → BBD

देखें:

A → B = +1
B → B = 0
C → D = +1

Rule:

+1, 0, +1

या कोई और clearly established alternating pattern हो सकता है।

इसलिए केवल एक question देखकर जल्दबाजी में rule नहीं लगाना है।

9. Type 6 — Position-Based Coding

Letter को उसकी numerical position में बदल दिया जाता है।

Example:

CAT

C = 3
A = 1
T = 20

तो:

CAT → 3, 1, 20

Example:

DOG

D = 4
O = 15
G = 7

तो:

DOG → 4-15-7

10. Type 7 — Letter Position का Mathematical Operation

कभी letter की position पर mathematical operation लगाया जाता है।

Example:

A → C

A = 1
C = 3

यहाँ:

1 + 2 = 3

इसी तरह:

D → H

D = 4
H = 8

यहाँ:

4 × 2 = 8

इसलिए Coding-Decoding में सिर्फ letters नहीं, उनकी positions भी देखें।

11. Type 8 — Word Coding

कभी पूरा word किसी दूसरे word से code किया जाता है।

Example:

If CAT is coded as DBU, then DOG is coded as ?

पहले CAT → DBU का rule:

C → D = +1
A → B = +1
T → U = +1

अब DOG:

D → E
O → P
G → H

DOG → EPH

12. Type 9 — Word को Reverse करना

कभी केवल word का order उल्टा किया जाता है।

Example:

CAT → TAC

CAT के letters reverse:

C A T
↓ ↓ ↓
T A C

तो:

CAT → TAC

13. Reverse + Shift

यह CET में थोड़ा tricky हो सकता है।

मान लो:

AB → YZ

पहले reverse alphabet:

A → Z
B → Y

फिर output को एक position आगे/पीछे किया जा सकता है, depending on question rule.

इसलिए ऐसे questions में दो operations अलग-अलग identify करें:

Step 1 → Reverse
Step 2 → Shift

एक साथ guess मत करें।

14. Circular Alphabet

Alphabet का आखिरी letter Z है।

लेकिन coding में:

Z + 1 = A

और:

A − 1 = Z

इसे circular alphabet कहते हैं।

Example:

XYZ → YZA

X +1 = Y
Y +1 = Z
Z +1 = A

इसलिए:

XYZ → YZA

15. Important Circular Examples

+2

Y + 2 = A
क्योंकि:

Y → Z → A

+3

X + 3 = A

X → Y → Z → A

−2

B − 2 = Z

B → A → Z

16. Coding-Decoding में Direction

यह बहुत important है।

अगर दिया है:

A → D

तो पूछना है:

A से D कैसे पहुँचे?

A = 1
D = 4

Difference:

+3

अब यही +3 दूसरे letter पर लगाएँ।

17. सबसे महत्वपूर्ण Rule-Finding Method 🧠

किसी भी Coding question को देखकर यह order follow करें:

Step 1:

Letter positions लिखो

Step 2:

देखो क्या + / − shift है।

Step 3:

अगर नहीं है तो reverse alphabet check करो।

Step 4:

फिर different/increasing shift check करो।

Step 5:

फिर alternate pattern check करो।

Step 6:

फिर reverse order check करो।

Step 7:

फिर circular alphabet check करो।

Step 8:

जरूरत पड़े तो mathematical operation on positions check करो।

18. Coding-Decoding का Master Checklist

Pattern

क्या देखना है

+1

हर letter एक आगे

−1

हर letter एक पीछे

+2 / +3

Fixed forward shift

−2 / −3

Fixed backward shift

Reverse

A↔Z, B↔Y

Circular

Z→A / A→Z

Different Shift

+1,+2,+3...

Alternate

अलग-अलग positions पर अलग rule

Reverse Order

CAT → TAC

Position Coding

A=1, B=2...

Mathematical

Position पर +, −, ×, ÷

Mixed

दो या अधिक rules

19. Exam में सबसे पहले क्या Check करें?

अगर question है:

APPLE → ?

तो तुरंत पूरा calculation शुरू मत करो।

पहले देखें:

A → ?
P → ?
P → ?
L → ?
E → ?

फिर positions compare करो।

उदाहरण:

अगर:

APPLE → BQQMF

तो:

A→B = +1
P→Q = +1
P→Q = +1
L→M = +1
E→F = +1

Rule मिल गया:

हर letter +1

20. सबसे बड़ा CET Trap ⚠️

Forward Shift ≠ Reverse Alphabet

उदाहरण:

C → D

यह +1 shift है।

लेकिन:

C → X

यह Reverse Alphabet है।

इसी तरह:

A → Z

Reverse alphabet भी हो सकता है और A−1 circular भी।

इसलिए पूरे question के context से rule confirm करें।

🔥 PART 5A — One-Page Revision

Coding-Decoding में सबसे पहले याद रखें:

1. A=1, B=2 ... Z=26

2. Forward: A→B→C

3. Backward: C→B→A

4. Reverse: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X

5. Circular: Z→A और A→Z

6. Position: Letter को number में बदलना

7. Different Shift: +1,+2,+3...

8. Alternate: अलग positions पर अलग rule

9. Reverse Order: CAT→TAC

10. Mixed Coding: दो या अधिक rules combine हो सकते हैं।

⭐ Master Formula:

Letter → Position → Difference → Pattern → Apply Rule

PART 5B — LETTER CODING 🔐

1. Letter Coding का Basic Format

Question अक्सर इस तरह आता है:

If CAT is coded as DBU, then DOG is coded as ?

पहले दिए हुए word का rule निकालना है।

CAT → DBU

Original

Position

Code

Position

Change

C

3

D

4

+1

A

1

B

2

+1

T

20

U

21

+1

Rule = हर letter +1

अब DOG:

D → E
O → P
G → H

Answer: EPH

2. Type 1 — Same Forward Shift

हर letter को समान संख्या से आगे बढ़ाया जाता है।

Example:

BAD → E D G

B → E = +3
A → D = +3
D → G = +3

तो:

CAT → ?

C +3 = F
A +3 = D
T +3 = W

Answer = FDW

3. Type 2 — Same Backward Shift

हर letter को समान संख्या से पीछे किया जाता है।

Example:

DOG → BME

D → B = −2
O → M = −2
G → E = −2

अब:

CAT → ?

C → A
A → Y
T → R

Answer = AYR

4. Type 3 — Different Shift

हर letter पर अलग shift लगाया जाता है।

Example:

ABC → BDF

A → B = +1
B → D = +2
C → F = +3

Rule:

+1, +2, +3

अब:

DEF → ?

D +1 = E
E +2 = G
F +3 = I

Answer = EGI

5. Type 4 — Increasing / Decreasing Shift

Shift लगातार बढ़ या घट सकता है।

Example:

ABCDE → BDFHJ

देखें:

A→B = +1
B→D = +2
C→F = +3
D→H = +4
E→J = +5

Rule:

+1, +2, +3, +4, +5

Decreasing Example

ABCDE → ZYWVS

यहाँ:

A→Z = −1
B→Y = −3?

इसलिए ऐसे questions में बिना पूरा pattern verify किए rule assume नहीं करना चाहिए।

Exam Trick:

कम से कम 3 letters का pattern verify करें।

6. Type 5 — Reverse Alphabet Coding

यह बहुत important है।

Reverse pairs:

A ↔ Z
B ↔ Y
C ↔ X
D ↔ W
E ↔ V
F ↔ U
G ↔ T
H ↔ S
I ↔ R
J ↔ Q
K ↔ P
L ↔ O
M ↔ N

Example:

CAT → XZG

C → X
A → Z
T → G

इसलिए:

DOG → ?

D → W
O → L
G → T

Answer = WLT

7. Type 6 — Reverse Alphabet + Shift

यह थोड़ा tricky है।

मान लो:

B → X

Reverse alphabet में:

B → Y

फिर:

Y − 1 = X

इसलिए rule:

Reverse + −1

अब:

D → ?

D का reverse:

D → W

W − 1 = V

Answer = V

8. Type 7 — Circular Letter Coding

Alphabet circular तरीके से चलता है।

A B C ... X Y Z A B C...

इसलिए:

Z + 1 = A
Z + 2 = B
Y + 2 = A

Example:

XYZ → YZA

X→Y
Y→Z
Z→A

अब:

YZA → ?

Y→Z
Z→A
A→B

Answer = ZAB

9. Type 8 — Reverse Order Coding

इसमें letters का order उल्टा हो जाता है।

Example:

CAT → TAC

Original:

C A T

Reverse:

T A C

इसलिए:

DOG → GOD

10. Type 9 — Reverse Order + Shift

दो operations हो सकते हैं।

Example:

CAT → UBD

पहले reverse:

CAT → TAC

फिर +1:

T→U
A→B
C→D

इसलिए:

CAT → UBD

अब DOG:

DOG → GOD

+1:

G→H
O→P
D→E

Answer = HPE

⭐ Trick:

अगर output देखकर समझ नहीं आ रहा:

पहले order reverse करो → फिर shift check करो।

11. Type 10 — Pair-wise Letter Coding

अगर word में letters pair में दिए हैं, तो हर pair को अलग-अलग देखना है।

Example:

AB → CD

A→C = +2
B→D = +2

अब:

EF → ?

E→G
F→H

Answer = GH

12. Type 11 — Different Shift in Pair

Example:

AB → CE

A→C = +2
B→E = +3

अब:

DF → ?

D +2 = F
F +3 = I

Answer = FI

13. Type 12 — Alternate Letter Coding

कभी odd और even positions पर अलग rule होता है।

Example:

ABCDE → BCGDF

Check:

A→B = +1
B→C = +1
C→G = +4
D→D = 0
E→F = +1

इस तरह के question में pattern को position-by-position check करना जरूरी है।

CET Tip:

अगर normal shift काम नहीं कर रहा:

1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th... positions अलग-अलग compare करो।

14. Type 13 — Letter Position Coding

कभी letters को सीधे numbers में बदला जाता है।

Example:

CAT

C = 3
A = 1
T = 20

तो:

CAT → 3-1-20

दूसरा Example:

DOG

D = 4
O = 15
G = 7

DOG → 4-15-7

15. Type 14 — Position + Operation

कभी position पर mathematical operation लगाया जाता है।

Example:

B → E

B = 2
E = 5

Rule:

2 + 3 = 5

अब:

D → ?

D = 4

4 + 3 = 7

7 = G

Answer = G

16. Type 15 — Position × Operation

Example:

B → F

B = 2
F = 6

Rule:

2 × 3 = 6

अब:

C → ?

C = 3

3 × 3 = 9

9 = I

Answer = I

17. Type 16 — Position-Based Square

यह relatively tricky pattern है।

Example:

C → I

C = 3

3² = 9

9 = I

इसलिए:

C → I

अगर:

D → ?

D = 4

4² = 16

16 = P

Answer = P

⚠️ इसे तभी लगाएँ जब दिए गए examples से square rule clearly establish हो।

18. Type 17 — Word के हर Letter पर Same Rule

Example:

MANGO → ?

अगर rule है +2, तो:

M→O
A→C
N→P
G→I
O→Q

Answer = OCPIQ

19. Type 18 — Vowels और Consonants अलग Rule

कभी advanced coding में vowels और consonants पर अलग-अलग rule दिया जा सकता है।

Example rule:

  • Vowel → +1
  • Consonant → +2

CAT

C consonant → E
A vowel → B
T consonant → V

CAT → EBV

ऐसे questions में question में दिया हुआ rule follow करें; खुद से vowel/consonant rule invent नहीं करना है।

20. Type 19 — Letter Pair का Reverse

Example:

AB → YZ

Reverse alphabet:

A → Z
B → Y

लेकिन output YZ है, इसलिए order बदल गया:

A→Z, B→Y gives ZY, जबकि YZ में order भी reverse हुआ।

इसलिए ऐसे questions में हमेशा दो चीजें check करें:

1.    Individual letter mapping

A) RIAHC
B) RIHAC
C) RIAHC
D) RAIHC

🔹 SECTION C — TRICKY CET CODING

Q9. Reverse Alphabet + Shift

पहले अक्षरों का reverse alphabet लिया जाता है और फिर प्रत्येक अक्षर में +1 किया जाता है।

CAT → ?

A) YAH
B) YZG
C) XBH
D) ZAH

Q10. Reverse Order + Shift

पहले word को reverse किया जाता है और फिर प्रत्येक अक्षर में +1 किया जाता है।

DOG → ?

A) HPE
B) HPE
C) HPE
D) HOF

Q11. Alternate Coding

पहले अक्षर में +1, दूसरे में −1, तीसरे में +1, चौथे में −1 किया जाता है।

MATH → ?

A) NZUG
B) NBSG
C) LBSG
D) NZSH

Q12. Pair-wise Coding

प्रत्येक पहले अक्षर को +2 और दूसरे अक्षर को +3 किया जाता है।

AB → ?

A) CD
B) CE
C) DE
D) BF

🔹 SECTION D — NUMBER CODING

Q13. Position Sum

A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26.

BAT का code क्या होगा?

A) 21
B) 23
C) 25
D) 27

Q14. Position Product

A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26.

BAD का code = ?

A) 24
B) 28
C) 32
D) 36

Q15. First + Last

किसी word का code = पहले अक्षर की position + अंतिम अक्षर की position.

COLD → ?

A) 7
B) 8
C) 9
D) 10

Q16. Reverse Position Sum

Reverse alphabet position में:

Z=1, Y=2, ..., A=26.

CAT का code क्या होगा?

A) 43
B) 44
C) 45
D) 46

🔹 SECTION E — ARTIFICIAL / CHINESE LANGUAGE CODING

Q17.

एक artificial language में:

"ram eats food" → "ka ti mo"
"ram drinks water" → "ka su pe"

तो ram का code क्या है?

A) ka
B) ti
C) su
D) pe

Q18.

एक artificial language में:

"good boy" → "na ki"
"good girl" → "na lo"

तो good का code क्या है?

A) ki
B) lo
C) na
D) Cannot be determined

Q19.

एक artificial language में:

"red big ball" → "pa ko mi"
"red small ball" → "pa tu mi"

तो small का code क्या है?

A) pa
B) ko
C) mi
D) tu

🔹 SECTION F — FINAL CET MIXED

Q20. Position-Based Coding

A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26.

किसी word का code इस प्रकार बनाया जाता है:

(पहला अक्षर × अंतिम अक्षर) + बीच के अक्षरों की positions का sum

तो CAT का code क्या होगा?

A) 23
B) 24
C) 25
D) 26

chapters.content:
🩸 PART 5A — BLOOD RELATION BASICS

Rajasthan CET Reasoning | Basic → Exam Level

Blood Relation questions में आपको family members के बीच relation identify करना होता है। सबसे important skill है: generation + gender + relation को सही track करना।

1. Blood Relation क्या होता है?

जब दो लोगों के बीच परिवार/वंश के आधार पर संबंध हो, उसे Blood Relation कहते हैं।

Example:

A, B का बेटा है।

तो:

  • A → B का Son
  • B → A का Father या Mother हो सकता है।

यहाँ gender की information न हो तो exact relation हमेशा determine नहीं होगा।

2. सबसे पहले 3 चीजें पहचानो

हर question में ये 3 चीजें check करो:

① Gender — Male या Female?

② Generation — ऊपर, समान या नीचे?

③ Relation — Father, Brother, Uncle आदि?

यही Blood Relation की पूरी foundation है।

3. Generation समझो

इसे ऐसे याद रखो:

           Grandfather / Grandmother

                    ↑

             Father / Mother

                    ↑

            You / Brother / Sister

                    ↓

              Son / Daughter

                    ↓

       Grandson / Granddaughter

Generation Levels

Generation

Relations

+2

Grandfather, Grandmother

+1

Father, Mother, Uncle, Aunt

0

Brother, Sister, Husband, Wife, Cousin

−1

Son, Daughter, Nephew, Niece

−2

Grandson, Granddaughter

4. सबसे Important Relations

👨 Male Relations

Relation

Meaning

Father

पिता

Son

बेटा

Brother

भाई

Husband

पति

Grandfather

दादा/नाना

Grandson

पोता/नाती

Uncle

चाचा/मामा/फूफा/मौसा

Nephew

भतीजा/भांजा

👩 Female Relations

Relation

Meaning

Mother

माँ

Daughter

बेटी

Sister

बहन

Wife

पत्नी

Grandmother

दादी/नानी

Granddaughter

पोती/नातिन

Aunt

चाची/मामी/फूफी/मौसी

Niece

भतीजी/भांजी

5. Father और Mother Side

यह CET में बहुत useful है।

Father's side

Father का भाई = Uncle

Father की बहन = Aunt

          Grandfather

              │

      ┌───────┴───────┐

    Father           Uncle

      │                │

     You            Cousin

Mother's side

Mother का भाई = Maternal Uncle

Mother की बहन = Maternal Aunt

          Grandparents

               │

       ┌───────┴───────┐

     Mother           Uncle

       │                │

      You            Cousin

Exam में ध्यान दें:

Uncle सिर्फ चाचा नहीं होता।

Indian context में:

  • Father's brother → चाचा/ताऊ
  • Mother's brother → मामा
  • Father's sister's husband → फूफा
  • Mother's sister's husband → मौसा

लेकिन English reasoning में अक्सर इन सबके लिए Uncle इस्तेमाल होता है।

6. Brother और Sister

Brother

आपके माता-पिता का male child = Brother

Sister

आपके माता-पिता का female child = Sister

Example:

A और B भाई-बहन हैं।

अगर A male है → B उसकी sister हो सकती है।

अगर B male है → A उसका brother हो सकता है।

इसलिए gender information बहुत important है।

7. Son और Daughter

अगर कोई कहता है:

A is the son of B.

तो:

B

│

A

A = B का बेटा

और B = A का parent होगा।

लेकिन B male है या female, यह sentence से अकेले पता नहीं चलता।

8. Grandfather / Grandmother

Father का Father

= Grandfather

Father की Mother

= Grandmother

Mother का Father

= Grandfather

Mother की Mother

= Grandmother

यानी:

Father's Father → Grandfather

Father's Mother → Grandmother

 

Mother's Father → Grandfather

Mother's Mother → Grandmother

9. Uncle और Aunt

Father's Brother

= Uncle

Mother's Brother

= Uncle

Father's Sister

= Aunt

Mother's Sister

= Aunt

Basic CET questions में इतना identify करना काफी होता है।

10. Nephew और Niece

यह थोड़ा important है।

Brother/Sister का बेटा

= Nephew

Brother/Sister की बेटी

= Niece

Example:

        Parents

           │

     ┌─────┴─────┐

   Brother       You

      │

    Son

Brother का Son → Nephew

11. Cousin

Uncle/Aunt के son या daughter को generally Cousin कहते हैं।

Example:

          Grandparents

              │

       ┌──────┴──────┐

     Father         Uncle

       │               │

      You            Rahul

Rahul = You का Cousin

12. Husband और Wife

ये blood relation नहीं, बल्कि marital relation है।

Husband ↔ Wife

लेकिन reasoning में इन्हें Blood Relation chapter में ही questions के अंदर इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

13. सबसे जरूरी Family Tree Symbols

Questions solve करते समय paper पर symbols बनाओ:

♂ = Male

♀ = Female

 

─  = Marriage

│  = Parent → Child

Example:

     ♂────♀

       │

       │

       ♂

ऊपर वाले दोनों नीचे वाले के parents हैं।

14. एक Simple Family Tree

इसे समझ लो:

                 Grandfather ♂ ─── Grandmother ♀

                         │

             ┌───────────┴───────────┐

          Father ♂                 Uncle ♂

             │                         │

        Mother ♀                    Aunt ♀

             │                         │

          ┌──┴──┐                   Child

       Son ♂  Daughter ♀

यहाँ:

  • Father → Son का पिता
  • Mother → Son की माँ
  • Daughter → Son की sister
  • Uncle → Son का uncle
  • Aunt → Son की aunt
  • Uncle का Child → Son का cousin
  • Father → Uncle का brother
  • Son → Uncle का nephew

15. Direct Relation Questions

Example 1

A is the father of B.

A का B से relation?

👉 Father

Example 2

A is the daughter of B.

A का B से relation?

👉 Daughter

Example 3

A is the brother of B.

A का B से relation?

👉 Brother

Example 4

A is the mother of B.

B का A से relation?

👉 Son/Daughter

यहाँ B का gender दिया नहीं है, इसलिए exact answer नहीं बता सकते।

16. Direction बहुत Important है ⚠️

Question:

A is the brother of B.

पूछा:

B is related to A as?

Answer हमेशा:

👉 Brother नहीं, बल्कि B का gender अगर पता हो तभी Brother/Sister।

Example:

A is the brother of B, and B is female.

तो:

B → A = Sister

इसलिए हमेशा पूछे गए व्यक्ति से दूसरे व्यक्ति की तरफ relation निकालो।

17. CET का Golden Rule ⭐

Blood Relation में sentence पढ़कर तुरंत answer मत दो।

पहले:

Step 1 → Names लिखो

Step 2 → Gender mark करो

Step 3 → Family tree बनाओ

Step 4 → Generation देखो

Step 5 → पूछा गया relation निकालो

18. सबसे आसान Shortcut

अगर question लंबा है, तो सिर्फ relationship chain बनाओ।

Example:

A is the father of B. B is the sister of C.

पहले:

A

│

B ─── C

B और C siblings हैं।

A = B का father

इसलिए A = C का भी Father.

19. Relation Chain Method

मान लो:

A → Father of B
B → Brother of C

तो:

A

│

B ─── C

A = C का Father

Chain को छोटा करते जाओ:

Father → Brother/Sister → Same Parent

ऐसे questions बहुत जल्दी solve होते हैं।

20. सबसे ज्यादा होने वाली गलतियाँ ⚠️

❌ Mistake 1:

Father's brother को सिर्फ "Father" समझ लेना।

Correct:

Father's brother = Uncle

❌ Mistake 2:

Brother/Sister में gender ignore करना।

❌ Mistake 3:

Question किस direction में relation पूछ रहा है, यह भूल जाना।

❌ Mistake 4:

एक ही relation देखकर answer देना जबकि chain आगे जा रही हो।

❌ Mistake 5:

Cousin को Brother/Sister मान लेना।

🧠 6A MASTER NOTES

इसे याद कर लो:

Father's Father → Grandfather

Father's Mother → Grandmother

 

Mother's Father → Grandfather

Mother's Mother → Grandmother

 

Father's Brother → Uncle

Mother's Brother → Uncle

 

Father's Sister → Aunt

Mother's Sister → Aunt

 

Brother's/Sister's Son → Nephew

Brother's/Sister's Daughter → Niece

 

Uncle/Aunt's Son/Daughter → Cousin

 

Male child → Son

Female child → Daughter

 

Male sibling → Brother

Female sibling → Sister

⭐ Master Formula:

Gender + Generation + Direction + Family Tree = Blood Relation Answer

1. Family Tree क्या होता है?

Family Tree में हम family members को ऊपर से नीचे generation-wise arrange करते हैं।

Basic structure:

           Grandfather ─── Grandmother

                    │

          ┌─────────┴─────────┐

       Father                Uncle

          │                     │

       Mother                 Aunt

          │                     │

       ┌──┴──┐                Son

      You  Sister

इस tree को देखकर relation तुरंत निकाला जा सकता है।

2. Generation का सबसे आसान नियम ⭐

अपने reference person को Generation 0 मान लो।

        +2     Grandparents

               ↑

        +1     Parents / Uncle / Aunt

               ↑

         0    You / Brother / Sister / Cousin

               ↓

        -1     Son / Daughter / Nephew / Niece

               ↓

        -2     Grandson / Granddaughter

याद रखने का तरीका:

ऊपर = +

नीचे = −

3. Generation Level समझो

मान लो A reference person है।

A का Father

Father (+1)

   │

   A (0)

Father = +1 generation

A का Grandfather

Grandfather (+2)

      │

    Father (+1)

      │

      A (0)

Grandfather = +2

A का Son

A (0)

 │

Son (-1)

Son = −1

A का Grandson

A (0)

 │

Son (-1)

 │

Grandson (-2)

Grandson = −2

4. Same Generation क्या होता है?

जो लोग एक ही generation में हैं, वे generally same level पर होते हैं।

Example:

       Father

         │

    ┌────┴────┐

  A (0)      B (0)

A और B:

👉 Brother/Sister

दोनों same generation में हैं।

5. Sibling Relation

अगर दो लोगों के same parents हैं:

        Parents

           │

      ┌────┴────┐

      A         B

A और B = siblings

अगर दोनों male → Brothers

अगर दोनों female → Sisters

अगर एक male और एक female → Brother & Sister

6. Uncle की Generation

यह बहुत important है।

       Grandparents

            │

      ┌─────┴─────┐

   Father        Uncle

      │             │

      A           Cousin

Father और Uncle दोनों same generation में हैं।

लेकिन A के comparison में:

  • Father = +1
  • Uncle = +1
  • Cousin = 0

इसलिए Uncle और Father same generation के होते हैं।

7. Aunt की Generation

इसी तरह:

       Grandparents

            │

      ┌─────┴─────┐

   Mother        Aunt

      │             │

      A           Cousin

Mother और Aunt = same generation

A के लिए दोनों = +1

8. Cousin की Generation

अगर:

        Grandparents

             │

       ┌─────┴─────┐

     Father       Uncle

       │             │

       A           B

A और B दोनों:

👉 Same generation

👉 Cousins

इसलिए:

Uncle का son = आपके generation में होता है।

9. Nephew/Niece की Generation

Example:

        Parents

           │

      ┌────┴────┐

   Brother       A

      │

   Nephew

A और Brother = Generation 0

Nephew = Generation −1

इसीलिए:

Brother का son = Nephew

Brother की daughter = Niece

10. 3-Generation Family Tree

एक बड़ा example:

                 Grandfather

                      │

             ┌────────┴────────┐

           Father             Uncle

             │                  │

          Mother              Aunt

             │                  │

       ┌─────┴─────┐          Cousin

       A           Sister

       │

      Son

       │

    Grandson

अब A को reference मानते हैं:

Person

Generation

Grandfather

+2

Father

+1

Uncle

+1

Mother

+1

Aunt

+1

A

0

Sister

0

Cousin

0

Son

−1

Grandson

−2

11. Generation से Relation पहचानना

अगर कोई व्यक्ति:

+1 है

Possible relations:

  • Father
  • Mother
  • Uncle
  • Aunt

+2 है

Possible:

  • Grandfather
  • Grandmother

0 है

Possible:

  • Brother
  • Sister
  • Cousin
  • Husband
  • Wife

−1 है

Possible:

  • Son
  • Daughter
  • Nephew
  • Niece

−2 है

Possible:

  • Grandson
  • Granddaughter

लेकिन generation अकेले exact relation नहीं बताती।

Gender + family connection भी चाहिए।

12. Chain Method ⭐⭐⭐

CET में सबसे powerful technique:

हर relation को step-by-step follow करो।

Example:

A is the brother of B. B is the father of C.

पहले:

A ─── B

      │

      C

A और B brothers हैं।

B = C का Father

तो A = C का:

👉 Uncle

13. एक और Example

A is the sister of B. B is the father of C.

A ─── B

      │

      C

A = C की:

👉 Aunt

14. Two-Step Relation

Example:

A is the father of B. B is the father of C.

A

│

B

│

C

A = C का:

👉 Grandfather

क्यों?

Father + Father = Grandfather.

15. Three-Step Relation

A is father of B. B is father of C. C is father of D.

A

│

B

│

C

│

D

A = D का:

👉 Great Grandfather

CET के लिए:

Father → +1

Grandfather → +2

Great Grandfather → +3

16. Reverse Direction ⚠️

Question:

A is the father of B.

अगर पूछा:

B is related to A as?

Answer:

👉 Son/Daughter

अगर B male है → Son

अगर B female है → Daughter

इसलिए:

Statement की direction और question की direction अलग हो सकती है।

17. Family Tree बनाने का Golden Rule

जब भी लंबा question आए:

Step 1

सबसे पहले एक person चुनो।

Step 2

उसके ऊपर parents रखो।

Step 3

siblings को side में रखो।

Step 4

children को नीचे रखो।

Step 5

Gender mark करो।

Example:

       ♂ Father ─── ♀ Mother

                    │

             ┌──────┴──────┐

            ♂ A            ♀ B

18. Gender Symbols का इस्तेमाल

Notes में जल्दी बनाने के लिए:

♂ = Male

♀ = Female

 

│ = Parent → Child

─ = Husband/Wife

Example:

       ♂────♀

          │

     ┌────┴────┐

     ♂        ♀

ऊपर वाले = Parents

नीचे वाले = Son + Daughter

19. CET का Important Trap ⚠️

Question:

A is the brother of B.

इससे यह जरूरी नहीं कि B female हो।

B male भी हो सकता है।

अगर B male है:

A = Brother of B

अगर B female है:

A = Brother of B

इसलिए A का gender पता है, B का नहीं।

लेकिन अगर पूछा जाए:

B is related to A as?

तो B का gender जानना जरूरी है।

20. Maternal/Paternal Generation

Father's side:

Father's Brother → Uncle

Father's Sister → Aunt

Mother's side:

Mother's Brother → Uncle

Mother's Sister → Aunt

इन सबका generation आम तौर पर आपसे +1 है।

21. Family Tree में सबसे Powerful Shortcut 🧠

अगर relation chain में:

Same Parent

→ Brother/Sister

Parent का Brother

→ Uncle

Parent की Sister

→ Aunt

Brother/Sister का Child

→ Nephew/Niece

Uncle/Aunt का Child

→ Cousin

Parent का Parent

→ Grandparent

Child का Child

→ Grandchild

इसे याद कर लो।

22. Master Relation Chain

Parent

  ↓

You

  ↓

Child

और side relations:

        Grandparent

             │

      ┌──────┴──────┐

    Parent         Uncle/Aunt

       │               │

   ┌───┴───┐         Cousin

 You     Sibling

  │

Child

  │

Grandchild

🧠 6B MASTER NOTES

Generation Formula:

Grandparent = +2

Parent = +1

You/Sibling/Cousin = 0

Child/Nephew/Niece = −1

Grandchild = −2

Relation Formula:

Parent's Parent → Grandparent

 

Parent's Brother → Uncle

 

Parent's Sister → Aunt

 

Sibling's Son → Nephew

 

Sibling's Daughter → Niece

 

Uncle/Aunt's Son/Daughter → Cousin

 

Child's Child → Grandchild

⭐ Golden Method:

Question पढ़ो → Family Tree बनाओ → Gender देखो → Generation पहचानो → Question की direction में relation निकालो.

1. Direct Blood Relation क्या है?

जब question में किसी व्यक्ति का relation सीधे बताया गया हो, जैसे:

A is the father of B.

तो यह Direct Blood Relation है।

A → B = Father

2. सबसे पहले Direction समझो ⭐

यह सबसे important rule है।

Statement:

A is the father of B.

इसका मतलब:

A

⚠️ यही CET का trap है।

हर chain का answer automatically Aunt नहीं मानना है।

25. "His" और "Her" का इस्तेमाल

यह थोड़ा tricky है।

Example:

A pointed to B and said,
"He is the brother of my mother."

यहाँ my = A

इसलिए:

Mother's brother = A का Uncle.

लेकिन:

A pointed to B and said,
"He is the brother of her mother."

अब her किस female person को refer कर रहा है, यह context से determine करना पड़ेगा।

इसलिए pronoun को हमेशा carefully identify करो।

26. Introduction Type Question

कभी question pointing के बजाय introduction के रूप में आता है।

Example:

A introduced B as "the son of my brother."

तो B = A का:

👉 Nephew

27. "Introduced a Man"

A introduced a man and said,
"He is the husband of my sister."

Chain:

My Sister

    │

  Husband

👉 Brother-in-law

ध्यान दें:

यह blood relation नहीं, बल्कि marital relation है।

28. "My Daughter's Husband"

A said, "He is my daughter's husband."

👉 Son-in-law

29. "My Son's Wife"

"She is my son's wife."

👉 Daughter-in-law

30. "My Brother's Wife"

👉 Sister-in-law / भाभी

31. "My Sister's Husband"

👉 Brother-in-law / जीजा

32. Pointing + Gender Trick ⭐

अगर question कहता है:

Pointing to a man, A said...

तो pointed person = Male

अगर कहता है:

Pointing to a woman, A said...

तो pointed person = Female

यह information ambiguity हटाने में बहुत useful है।

33. Example — Gender से Answer

Pointing to a man, A said:
"He is my mother's child."

Mother's child = A या A का sibling.

लेकिन pointed person man है।

अगर A female है, तो वह उसका brother हो सकता है।

अगर A male है, तो वह A खुद भी हो सकता है—लेकिन pointed person generally another person होता है, इसलिए context देखना जरूरी है।

Lesson:

Gender clue को ignore मत करो, लेकिन उससे भी unsupported assumption मत बनाओ।

34. Fast Method ⚡

Pointing questions में पूरा sentence याद रखने की जरूरत नहीं।

बस chain निकालो:

Example:

My father's brother's son

Break:

Father

 ↓

Brother

 ↓

Son

Father's brother = Uncle

Uncle's son = Cousin

👉 Answer = Cousin

35. Long Chain Example

"He is my mother's sister's son."

Break:

Mother

  ↓

Sister

  ↓

Son

Mother's sister = Aunt

Aunt's son = Cousin

👉 Answer = Cousin

36. Another Long Chain

"She is my father's brother's daughter."

Father

  ↓

Brother

  ↓

Daughter

Father's brother = Uncle

Uncle's daughter = Cousin

👉 Answer = Cousin

37. Chain Compression Trick 🧠

कुछ chains को सीधे याद रखो:

Parent's sibling → Uncle/Aunt

 

Uncle/Aunt's child → Cousin

 

Sibling's child → Nephew/Niece

 

Parent's parent → Grandparent

 

Child's child → Grandchild

इससे long questions बहुत जल्दी solve होते हैं।

38. सबसे बड़ा Trap ⚠️

Example:

"My father's brother's son."

गलत:

Brother

सही:

Father

 ↓

Brother = Uncle

 ↓

Son = Cousin

👉 Cousin

39. दूसरा Trap

"My mother's sister's daughter."

गलत:

Sister

सही:

Mother

 ↓

Sister = Aunt

 ↓

Daughter = Cousin

👉 Cousin

40. Third Trap — Direction

A points to B and says,
"He is my brother's son."

पूछा:

How is B related to A?

Brother's son = Nephew

इसलिए B = A का Nephew.

लेकिन अगर पूछा:

How is A related to B?

तो:

A = Nephew का Uncle/Aunt होगा, depending on A's gender.

41. MASTER TABLE — Pointing Questions

My father                 → Father

My mother                 → Mother

My father's father        → Grandfather

My father's mother        → Grandmother

My mother's father        → Grandfather

My mother's mother        → Grandmother

 

My father's brother       → Uncle

My mother's brother       → Uncle

My father's sister        → Aunt

My mother's sister        → Aunt

 

My brother's son          → Nephew

My brother's daughter     → Niece

My sister's son           → Nephew

My sister's daughter      → Niece

 

My father's brother's son    → Cousin

My father's brother's daughter → Cousin

My mother's sister's son      → Cousin

My mother's sister's daughter → Cousin

42. 🔥 5-Second Method

Question:

Pointing to a person, A said,
"He is my father's brother's son."

बस chain:

Father → Brother → Son

अब:

Father's Brother = Uncle

Uncle's Son = Cousin

✅ Answer = Cousin

43. FINAL MASTER FORMULA ⭐⭐⭐

POINTING PERSON

       ↓

WHO IS SPEAKING?

       ↓

MY / HIS / HER

       ↓

BREAK THE CHAIN

       ↓

COMPRESS EACH RELATION

       ↓

CHECK GENDER

       ↓

CHECK DIRECTION

       ↓

FINAL RELATION

सबसे जरूरी shortcut:

Parent's sibling → Uncle/Aunt

Uncle/Aunt's child → Cousin

Sibling's child → Nephew/Niece

Parent's parent → Grandparent

1. सबसे पहले 5 Golden Rules ⭐⭐⭐

हर tricky question में ये 5 चीजें check करो:

Rule 1 — Direction

किसका relation किससे पूछा गया है?

Rule 2 — Gender

Male/Female information दी है या नहीं?

Rule 3 — Generation

ऊपर = Parent/Grandparent
नीचे = Child/Grandchild

Rule 4 — Chain

Relation को एक-एक step में तोड़ो।

Rule 5 — Assumption नहीं

जो information दी नहीं गई, उसे assume मत करो।

2. Long Chain को छोटा कैसे करें?

मान लो:

A → B का पिता
B → C की बहन

तो:

A

│

B ─── C

A = C का Father

Shortcut:

Father + Sister relation → दोनों siblings के parent same

3. Brother + Father Trap

Question:

A is the brother of B.
B is the father of C.

A ─── B

      │

      C

A = C का:

👉 Uncle

याद रखो:

Father's brother = Uncle

4. Sister + Father

A is the sister of B.
B is the father of C.

A ─── B

      │

      C

A = C की:

👉 Aunt

5. Brother + Mother

A is the brother of B.
B is the mother of C.

A ─── B

      │

      C

A = C का:

👉 Uncle

6. Sister + Mother

A is the sister of B.
B is the mother of C.

A = C की:

👉 Aunt

7. Two Generations ऊपर ⭐

Question:

A is father of B.
B is father of C.

A

│

B

│

C

A = C का:

👉 Grandfather

8. Three Generations ऊपर

A is father of B.
B is father of C.
C is father of D.

A

│

B

│

C

│

D

A = D का:

👉 Great-grandfather

Generation:

A → B = +1

A → C = +2

A → D = +3

9. Grandparent + Sibling

Question:

A is the grandfather of B.
C is the sister of B.

तो:

A

│

Parent

│

B ─── C

A = C का भी:

👉 Grandfather

क्योंकि B और C siblings हैं।

10. Uncle + Cousin

A is the uncle of B.
C is the son of A.

तो B और C का relation?

A = B का Uncle

A = C का Father

इसलिए:

👉 B और C = Cousins

11. Aunt + Daughter

A is the aunt of B.
C is the daughter of A.

तो:

B और C = Cousins

क्योंकि Aunt की daughter = Cousin.

12. Nephew/Niece Trap ⚠️

Question:

A is the brother of B.
C is the son of A.

C का B से relation?

A और B siblings हैं।

C = A का son.

इसलिए C = B का:

👉 Nephew

13. Sister's Daughter

A is the sister of B.
C is the daughter of A.

C = B की:

👉 Niece

14. Reverse Question

Question:

A is the brother of B.
B is the father of C.

How is C related to A?

Tree:

A ─── B

      │

      C

C = A का:

👉 Nephew/Niece

C का gender नहीं दिया गया, इसलिए exact gender-specific answer नहीं चुनना चाहिए।

15. Reverse Direction का बड़ा Trap ⚠️

Same tree:

A ─── B

      │

      C

A → C

Uncle

C → A

Nephew/Niece

Direction बदलते ही answer बदल गया।

16. Gender Trap

Question:

A is the brother of B. B is the brother of C.

इससे:

A ─── B ─── C

तीनों siblings हैं।

A male है।
B male है।
लेकिन C का gender नहीं बताया।

अगर पूछा:

A का C से relation?

👉 Brother/Sibling relation है, लेकिन C male/female unspecified है।

17. "Only Son" का इस्तेमाल

अगर question कहता है:

A is the only son of B.

तो:

  • A = Male
  • B = Parent
  • B के केवल एक male child की जानकारी है।

लेकिन इससे यह assume नहीं करना कि B की केवल एक ही संतान है।

हो सकता है B की daughters भी हों।

Important:

Only son ≠ Only child

18. "Only Daughter"

A is the only daughter of B.

इसका मतलब:

A = Female
B = Parent

लेकिन B के sons हो सकते हैं।

19. Husband-Wife वाला Tricky Question

Example:

A is the husband of B.
C is the daughter of B.

तो A = C का:

👉 Father

क्योंकि A और B married हैं और C, B की daughter है।

20. Brother's Wife

A is the brother of B.
C is the wife of A.

C का B से relation?

A = B का Brother

C = A की Wife

👉 Sister-in-law

21. Sister's Husband

A is the sister of B.
C is the husband of A.

C = B का:

👉 Brother-in-law

22. Daughter's Husband

A is the daughter of B.
C is the husband of A.

C = B का:

👉 Son-in-law

23. Son's Wife

A is the son of B.
C is the wife of A.

C = B की:

👉 Daughter-in-law

24. Pointing + Long Chain

Question:

A points to a man and says:

"He is my mother's brother's son."

Break it:

Mother

  ↓

Brother

  ↓

Son

Mother's brother = Uncle
Uncle's son = Cousin

👉 Pointed man = Cousin

25. Another Pointing Trap

A points to a woman and says,
"She is my father's brother's daughter."

Father

  ↓

Brother

  ↓

Daughter

Father's brother = Uncle
Uncle's daughter = Cousin

👉 Cousin

Woman सिर्फ gender confirm करता है।

26. "Mother's Father's Son"

यह थोड़ा tricky है।

He is my mother's father's son.

Break:

Mother

 ↓

Father

 ↓

Son

Mother's father = Maternal Grandfather

Grandfather's son could be:

  • Mother's brother
  • Possibly another son

अगर pointed person man है और conventional family setup में mother का brother intended है:

👉 Maternal Uncle

लेकिन अगर question में family structure पूरी तरह specify नहीं है, तो ambiguity हो सकती है।

CET Trick:

जहाँ multiple possibilities हों, options और additional information carefully check करो।

27. "Father's Mother's Daughter" ⚠️

She is my father's mother's daughter.

Father

 ↓

Mother

 ↓

Daughter

Father's mother = Grandmother.

Grandmother's daughter could be:

  • A की mother
  • A की aunt

इसलिए बिना additional information exact relation तय नहीं किया जा सकता।

⭐ Important:

Grandmother's daughter = हमेशा Aunt नहीं।

वह आपकी Mother भी हो सकती है।

28. "Mother's Brother's Son"

यह comparatively clear है:

Mother

 ↓

Brother

 ↓

Son

Mother's brother = Maternal Uncle

उनका son = Cousin

29. "Father's Sister's Daughter"

Father

 ↓

Sister

 ↓

Daughter

Father's sister = Aunt

Aunt's daughter = Cousin

30. Generation Shortcut ⭐⭐⭐

अगर chain है:

Parent → Child

तो 1 generation नीचे।

Parent → Child → Grandchild

तो 2 generations नीचे।

Formula:

Number of parent-child jumps = Generation difference

Example:

A → B → C → D

A और D में:

👉 3-generation difference

31. Same Generation Shortcut

अगर:

Grandparents

     │

 ┌───┴───┐

 A       B

A और B = same generation.

अगर A = Father और B = Uncle:

तो उनके children:

A → X

B → Y

X और Y = same generation

👉 Cousins

32. Family Tree Intersection Method 🧠

जब two people का relation निकालना हो:

दोनों की line ऊपर ले जाओ।

Example:

A

│

B

│

C

अगर A और C का relation चाहिए:

Common ancestor = A

A is C का Grandfather.

33. Common Ancestor Method

Example:

       P

      / \

     A   B

     │   │

     X   Y

X और Y:

  • A और B siblings
  • X = A का child
  • Y = B का child

👉 X और Y = Cousins

34. Blood Relation का Most Powerful Concept ⭐

Common Parent

Same parent:

👉 Siblings

Common Grandparent + Different Parent branches:

👉 Cousins

Example:

        Grandparent

          /     \

      Parent   Uncle

        │        │

        A        B

A और B = Cousins.

35. CET में "Cannot be Determined"

यह option बहुत important है।

अगर question में:

  • Gender missing
  • Family structure incomplete
  • Multiple possible relations

तो answer Cannot be Determined हो सकता है।

Example:

A is the brother of B.
How is B related to A?

B का gender नहीं दिया।

इसलिए:

👉 Brother या Sister

Exact answer = Cannot be determined, यदि ऐसा option दिया गया हो।

36. लेकिन हर बार "Cannot be Determined" मत लगाना ⚠️

अगर:

A is the brother of B.
B is the daughter of C.

अब B female है।

A = B का brother.

इसलिए A = C का Son.

यहाँ answer determined है।

37. Mixed Family Tree Example

मान लो:

        P ─── Q

          │

      ┌───┴───┐

      A       B

              │

              C

जहाँ A और B siblings हैं।

B = C का parent.

तो:

  • A = C का Uncle/Aunt (A के gender पर depend)
  • P/Q = C के Grandparents
  • C = A का Nephew/Niece

38. Exam में Family Tree कैसे बनाएं? ⚡

पूरा सुंदर diagram बनाने की जरूरत नहीं।

बस:

Father = F

Mother = M

Brother = B

Sister = S

Son = So

Daughter = D

Example:

Father's brother's son

लिखो:

F → B → So

फिर:

Uncle → Cousin

39. Ultra-Fast Chain Rules

Parent's Brother → Uncle

Parent's Sister → Aunt

 

Uncle/Aunt's Son → Cousin

Uncle/Aunt's Daughter → Cousin

 

Brother's Son → Nephew

Brother's Daughter → Niece

 

Sister's Son → Nephew

Sister's Daughter → Niece

 

Parent's Parent → Grandparent

Child's Child → Grandchild

40. 🔥 FINAL CET SOLVING FORMULA

हर tricky question में:

QUESTION

   ↓

IDENTIFY SPEAKER / REFERENCE

   ↓

MARK MALE / FEMALE

   ↓

BREAK RELATION INTO STEPS

   ↓

BUILD MINI FAMILY TREE

   ↓

COUNT GENERATIONS

   ↓

FIND COMMON PARENT/ANCESTOR

   ↓

CHECK DIRECTION

   ↓

CHECK IF ANY AMBIGUITY

   ↓

ANSWER

🧠 6F MASTER NOTES — ONE PAGE REVISION

Relations:

Parent's Brother → Uncle

Parent's Sister → Aunt

 

Uncle/Aunt's Child → Cousin

 

Sibling's Son → Nephew

Sibling's Daughter → Niece

 

Parent's Parent → Grandparent

Child's Child → Grandchild

Generation:

Grandparent = +2

Parent = +1

Self/Sibling/Cousin = 0

Child = −1

Grandchild = −2

Traps:

Direction बदलने पर relation बदलता है.

Gender assume नहीं करना.

Only son ≠ only child.

Grandmother's daughter हमेशा Aunt नहीं होती.

Grandfather's son हमेशा Uncle नहीं होता.

Uncle/Aunt's child = Cousin.

Sibling's child = Nephew/Niece.

⭐ Golden Formula:

GENDER + GENERATION + DIRECTION + CHAIN + COMMON ANCESTOR = ANSWER

🟢 BASIC LEVEL — Q1–Q5

Q1.

A is the father of B. B is the sister of C.
A is C's:

A) Brother
B) Father
C) Uncle
D) Grandfather

Q2.

P is the mother of Q. Q is the brother of R.
P is R's:

A) Aunt
B) Sister
C) Mother
D) Grandmother

Q3.

A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C.
A is C's:

A) Son
B) Brother
C) Father
D) Uncle

Q4.

M is the daughter of N. N is the son of O.
M is O's:

A) Daughter
B) Granddaughter
C) Sister
D) Niece

Q5.

X is the sister of Y. Y is the father of Z.
X is Z's:

A) Mother
B) Aunt
C) Sister
D) Grandmother

🟡 MEDIUM LEVEL — Q6–Q10

Q6.

A is the brother of B. B is the mother of C.
A is C's:

A) Father
B) Uncle
C) Brother
D) Grandfather

Q7.

P is the father of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the father of S.
P is S's:

A) Father
B) Uncle
C) Grandfather
D) Brother

Q8.

A is the mother of B. B is the father of C. C is the sister of D.
A is D's:

A) Mother
B) Grandmother
C) Aunt
D) Sister

Q9.

M is the sister of N. N is the brother of O. O is the father of P.
M is P's:

A) Aunt
B) Mother
C) Sister
D) Grandmother

Q10.

R is the son of S. S is the daughter of T. T is the son of U.
R is U's:

A) Son
B) Grandson
C) Great-grandson
D) Nephew

🔴 TRICKY CET LEVEL — Q11–Q15

Q11.

A is the only son of B. C is the daughter of A.
B is C's:

A) Father
B) Grandfather
C) Uncle
D) Brother

Q12.

P is the only daughter of Q. R is the son of P.
Q is R's:

A) Father or Mother
B) Uncle
C) Grandfather or Grandmother
D) Brother

Q13.

A is the brother of B. B is the wife of C.
A is C's:

A) Brother
B) Brother-in-law
C) Father-in-law
D) Uncle

Q14.

M is the sister of N. N is married to O.
M is O's:

A) Sister-in-law
B) Mother
C) Daughter
D) Aunt

Q15.

A points to B and says:

“He is the son of my mother's only daughter.”

If A is a male, B is A's:

A) Brother
B) Son
C) Nephew
D) Cousin

🔥 ADVANCED CET LEVEL — Q16–Q20

Q16.

A is the father of B. B is the brother of C. C is the mother of D.
A is D's:

A) Father
B) Grandfather
C) Uncle
D) Great-grandfather

Q17.

P is the sister of Q. Q is the father of R. R is the brother of S.
P is S's:

A) Mother
B) Aunt
C) Sister
D) Grandmother

Q18.

A is the mother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D.
A is D's:

A) Mother
B) Aunt
C) Grandmother
D) Sister

Q19.

X is the brother of Y. Y is the daughter of Z. Z is the brother of W.
X is W's:

A) Son
B) Nephew
C) Brother
D) Cousin

Q20.

A points to a woman and says:

“She is the daughter of the only son of my father's father.”

The woman is A's:

A) Sister
B) Daughter
C) Aunt
D) Cousin

4. Right Turn aur Left Turn

              N
